newsList.title: Runs Stored on Twitch's Servers will no longer be accepted.
newsList.body:
# Regarding New Runs from Twitch

[Since Twitch has announced that they will no longer store VODs from users with 100 hours of footage saved on site](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/video-on-demand?language=en_US), we will no longer be accepting runs with video evidence from Twitch. Thankfully, Twi

game.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
game.rules: Video proof is required. As of March 1 2025, runs stored on Twitch will no longer be accepted. Please export video evidence to YouTube prior to submission.

categories.name: Century Smash
categories.rules:
- IGT is the main timing method for this category, please do not submit with Real Time.
- Video proof is required.

categories.name: Classic 0.0
categories.rules:
- Timing starts on selecting "Let's go!" after choosing Intensity 0.0 and ends on the final hit or when the In-game timer stops in the final round.
- IGT is optional. If you wish to include it in your submission, calculate each stages starting time and subtract the time completed, then add up all 8 stages individual times for the total In-game time.
- Continues are allowed.
- Video proof is required.

categories.name: Classic 5.0
categories.rules:
- Timing starts on selecting "Let's go!" after choosing Intensity 5.0 and ends on the final hit or when the In-game timer stops in the final round.
- IGT is optional. If you wish to include it in your submission, calculate each stages starting time and subtract the time completed, then add up all 8 stages individual times for the total In-game time.
- Dropping below 5.0 is prohibited.
- Continues are allowed.
- Using a ticket, after going game over, to keep the Intensity above 5.0 is allowed.
- Video proof is required.

categories.name: Century Smash
categories.rules:
- IGT is the main timing method for this category, please do not submit with Real Time.
- Video proof is required.

categories.name: Unlock All Characters
categories.rules:
- Timing starts on pressing any button at the start screen (clearing DLC, Mii Costumes, Spirits, and in-game notifications before timing starts is allowed) and ends once the final character is unlocked.
- Must play on a new game with no previous data.
- Presetting a ruleset after loading up the game for the first time is prohibited.
- Video proof is required.

categories.name: All Challenges
categories.rules:
- Taking advantage of the SP boost during Spirit Board Events is banned.
- If the run time is less than 20 hours: "Have the game powered on for a total of 20 hours." must only be cleared with a Hammer.

categories.name: Classic 9.9
categories.rules:
- Timing starts on selecting "Let's go!" after choosing any Intensity and ends on the final hit or when the In-game timer stops in the final round.
- IGT is optional. If you wish to include it in your submission, calculate each stages starting time and subtract the time completed, then add up all 8 stages individual times for the total In-game time.
- Must finish with Intensity 9.9 in order to submit.
- Continues are allowed.
- Using a ticket, after going game over, to keep Intensity 9.9 is allowed.
- Video proof is required.
